name: Diamondback Energy
description: Diamondback is a pure-play Permian Basin oil producer: it drilled 463 horizontal wells in 2025 and produced about 921,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day, roughly 54 percent of it oil (497,156 barrels a day of oil). It sells crude, gas and natural gas liquids at market prices, so revenue ($15.0 billion in 2025) and profit move with oil prices and with volume added by acquisitions (Endeavor, then Double Eagle on April 1, 2025). It also controls Viper Energy, a listed mineral-and-royalty company (about 42 percent owned on a fully diluted basis) that collects royalties on Permian acreage without paying drilling costs. It returns at least half of adjusted free cash flow through a base dividend, buybacks and variable dividends, and had booked large impairments ($3.7 billion in Q4 2025, $1.4 billion in Q1 2026).
